## About
Edit Tools <cy>adds several useful tools</c> to the Geometry Dash editor

It <cf>includes tools</c> for:

- connecting objects between two selected points
- filling an area with objects
- replacing one object type with another
- replicating the first object's type onto other objects
- creating circles of objects
- connecting triggers to objects
- disconnecting triggers from objects
- wrapping selected triggers into a spawned setup

The mod also includes a <cy>optional toolbar buttons</c>, configurable hotkeys, and <cy>settings for each tool</c>

For a more convenient experience, it is <cg>recommended to install</c> **Relocate Edit Buttons** by enimeoww:

<mod:loovigmd.relocate_edit_buttons>
changelog:
# v1.2.1
- fixed an editor bug related to tool usage
- made small improvements to the tools menu
- improved trigger tool behavior

# v1.2.0
- added Replicate Object tool
- added Spawn Triggers tool
- connect trigger now also supports trigger-to-trigger setup
- added toolbar buttons, hotkeys, and settings for the new tools
- improved tools popup layout and added info buttons for each tool
- selection refresh now also updates edit menu and object info

# v1.1.0
- added fill outline option
- added swap both option for replace type
- improved connect, fill, replace, and circle behavior
- updated popup look and mod description

# v1.0.0
- Initial release
